_description: Zalcano (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Zalcano, /Strategies, Rock_Formation, Tephra, Refined_tephra, Imbued_tephra, Golem_(Zalcano), Demonic_Symbol, Zalcano_shard, Smolcano). Names are cache gamevals; tiles are the Wiki's and the map's. Values under a `_calibrated` note have no Wiki figure and are estimates.

prison._bounds: the room behind the barrier (map square 47,94)
prison._outside: 237/04057: leaving the prison lands here, east of the Teleport Platform (3282,6060 was a 3-tile pocket closed by lamps and trees)
prison._rocks: the map's own rock formations (south-west corners of the 3x3 locs); the Wiki lists them a tile further north-east
prison._firstRockWeights: north-west, north-east, south-west, south-east: the Wiki has north-east likeliest; the weights themselves are estimates

zalcano._shockwaveDelay: rsprox 4057: "stands" at 570 and 752, the shockwave (the tephra destroyed) at 576 and 758.

tephra._calibrated: the Wiki gives no tephra mining rate: the chance per attempt at a glowing rock and an ordinary one, and the extra ore a glowing rock can give

mining._maxHit: by Mining level, plus max((pickaxe level - 40) / 15, 0)

attacks._calibrated: the Wiki gives no intervals: how often she attacks, how often the glowing rock moves, how many boulders fall, how long symbols last and how fast the golem walks
attacks._symbolsRecorded: rsprox 4057: a blue symbol's line and spotanim on stepping on, then every 5 ticks while stood on (empowerPulse); each burn has the line, the hit, "Agh!" and spotanim zalcano_pentagram_burning on its tick.

rewards._points: main points: health + 2 x shield damage; tertiary points: min(health, 400) + 2 x min(shield, 300)
rewards._calibrated: the Wiki doesn't give how quantities scale with points: they run linearly from the table's minimum to its maximum at fullPoints

messages._recorded: rsprox 4056/4057 and 1073-1075 (rev 237, Leagues VI): entryWarning, entryQuestion and entryOptions (Pass, entering), the peek box's empty, full-health sentence, swingRock / mined / full / shard, refined, imbued / noRefined, empowered / lastOne, burning, swingZalcano / chipped, fallen, stands, rises, killCount. Message boxes: entryWarning, peek, full; spam: swing*, mined, refined, imbued, empowered, burning, chipped; the rest game messages.
messages.entryWarning: Zalcano's Prison is a dangerous environment and dying within will not be considered a safe death. Are you sure you wish to enter?
messages.entryQuestion: Are you sure you wish to enter?
messages._peek: Recorded: "There are no adventurers within the prison. Zalcano is present and at full health." The other counts and her damage fill the same sentence: calibrated.
messages.peek: There {verb} {players} within the prison. Zalcano is present and {health}.
messages.swingRock: You swing your pick at the rock.
messages.mined: You manage to mine some tephra.
messages.full: Your inventory is too full to hold any more tephra.
messages.refined: You heat the tephra in the furnace and smelt it down into a refined lump.
messages.imbued: You bind the altar's power into some refined tephra.
messages.noRefined: You do not have anything suitable for imbuing.
messages.empowered: You feel the symbol beneath your feet fill you with power.
messages.burning: You feel the symbol beneath your feet burning through you.
messages.swingZalcano: You swing your pick at Zalcano.
messages.chipped: You chip away at Zalcano and deal some damage to her.
messages.fallen: <col=ff0000>Zalcano falls to the ground, hurt and vulnerable.</col>
messages.stands: <col=ff0000>Zalcano stands from the floor, ready to fight back.</col>
messages.rises: <col=ff0000>A shockwave from Zalcano destroys your tephra.</col>
messages._noImbued: Recorded (rsprox 4057 ticks 99 and 225): attacking her with no imbued tephra.
messages.noImbued: You need to bring Zalcano down before you can do any damage to her.
messages._unverified: No recording has these: the quest refusal, the pickaxe and tephra refusals, mineHer, invulnerable and tooLittle.
messages.needQuest: You need to have completed Song of the Elves to enter Zalcano's prison.
messages.noPickaxe: You need a pickaxe to mine this.
messages.noTephra: You have no tephra to refine.
messages.mineHer: Zalcano has fallen: mine her with a pickaxe.
messages.invulnerable: Zalcano can only be harmed with imbued tephra.
messages.tooLittle: You didn't contribute enough to receive a reward.
